articles.summary: Venture Global (VG) reported 3Q26 earnings of $2.5BN last Tuesday, making its $30BN market cap look oddly cheap. A one-time interest rate swap gain of $1.4BN was significant, but even adjusting for that the stock closed at less than 7X annualized earnings following their quarterly release.
